framework.name: OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications
framework.description: Authoritative OWASP Top 10 security risk taxonomy for Large Language Model and Generative AI applications.

controls.title: Prompt Injection
controls.description: Crafted direct user inputs or indirect external data sources manipulate the Large Language Model's instruction hierarchy, leading to unauthorized instruction execution, policy bypass, or context hijacking.

controls.title: Sensitive Information Disclosure
controls.description: Failure to prevent the LLM or its surrounding application pipeline from disclosing confidential data, credentials, API keys, proprietary business logic, or regulated PII in model responses.

controls.title: Excessive Agency
controls.description: Granting an LLM-based system unconstrained permissions, excessive tool access, or autonomous execution capability without deterministic parameter validation and human-in-the-loop authorization gates.

controls.title: Supply Chain Vulnerabilities
controls.description: Risks arising from compromised pre-trained model weights, third-party adapters, model hosting providers, or unverified plugin/MCP dependencies in the AI lifecycle.

controls.title: Data and Model Poisoning
controls.description: Manipulation of pre-training, fine-tuning, or RAG knowledge corpus data to introduce backdoors, persistent biases, or targeted adversarial triggers.

controls.title: Unbounded Consumption
controls.description: Allowing unconstrained inference requests, missing max_tokens ceilings, recursive agent loops, or resource-amplifying prompts that result in Denial of Service (DoS) or financial Denial of Wallet (DoW).

controls.title: Misinformation and Overreliance
controls.description: Uncritical downstream reliance on hallucinated, ungrounded, or non-deterministic LLM outputs without citation verification or deterministic validation.

controls.title: System Prompt Leakage
controls.description: Exposure of hidden system instructions, internal prompt templates, proprietary routing rules, or sensitive credentials embedded within the system prompt preamble.

controls.title: Vector and Embedding Weaknesses
controls.description: Security flaws in RAG vector databases, chunking pipelines, embedding generation, and metadata filtering that enable cross-tenant document leakage, filter manipulation, or retrieval poisoning.

controls.title: Improper Output Handling
controls.description: Insufficient validation, sanitization, and context-aware encoding of LLM responses before passing them to downstream browsers, Markdown renderers, SQL databases, or OS command sinks.
